Parts.Description: Blue-grey city paving, a lawn park and a huge red hero emblem under the Shiba.

Parts.Description: The stepped blue headquarters of the heroes with a helipad crown and a tall radio spire.
Parts.Name: HQ Tower

Parts.Description: A roadside billboard on two steel legs that shouts HERO HQ to everybody passing by.
Parts.Name: Hero Billboard

Parts.Description: A white and blue jet with a red nose parked on its landing apron.
Parts.Name: Hero Jet

Parts.Description: An open workshop with a red roof and the blue sports car of the hero inside.

Parts.Description: A rubber training yard with a wall, a pull-up bar, a balance beam, tyres and a punching bag.
Parts.Name: Training Course

Parts.Description: A white lab with a big observatory dome, a water tank and a radio antenna.
Parts.Name: Gadget Lab

Parts.Description: A round fountain with a tall spray and two benches to rest on between rescues.
Parts.Name: Hero Fountain

Parts.Description: Four tall flagpoles with red and blue hero banners flapping in the wind.
Parts.Name: Hero Banners

Parts.Description: A yellow comic book shop with a striped awning and a big speech bubble sign.
Parts.Name: Comic Shop

Parts.Description: A yellow snack truck with a striped awning where the sidekicks grab their lunch.
Parts.Name: Snack Truck

Parts.Description: A boxing ring with blue corner posts and red ropes for the sidekicks to train in.

Parts.Description: A steel lattice tower holding a giant searchlight that calls the hero.

Parts.Description: A red and white rescue helicopter on a round helipad, ready for the next emergency.

Parts.Description: A tall power coil with glowing rings, a ball on top and four short pylons.

Parts.Description: A rocket on its launch pad with swept fins and a steel gantry, ready to carry the hero to space.
Parts.Name: Hero Rocket

Parts.Description: A huge statue of the hero with a flowing red cape and a raised fist on a stone pedestal.
Parts.Name: Hero Statue

Parts.Description: A grand stone hall with four columns, a dome and a statue gallery for the greatest heroes.
Parts.Name: Hall of Heroes
